quests.instruction: Which word means the people in your family line from long ago, going back many generations?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word describes family from the past, not the present.
quests.explanation: Ancestors means the people in your family line from long ago, going back many generations.
quests.funFact: Everyone has thousands of ancestors if you count back far enough in history!

quests.instruction: Which word means the gap between a parent's age group and a child's age group?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word measures the age-based distance between parent and child.
quests.explanation: Generation means the gap between a parent's age group and a child's age group.
quests.funFact: The phrase 'generation gap' describes differences between an older and a younger generation!

quests.instruction: Which word means the people in your immediate family who share your daily home life?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: This word is about daily life shared under one roof.
quests.explanation: Household means the people in your immediate family who share your daily home life.
quests.funFact: Your household is often the very group of people who know your daily routine best!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the family members you see every single day?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: These are the relatives who are part of your everyday life.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family describes the family members you see every single day.
quests.funFact: Your immediate family usually knows your daily schedule better than anyone else!

quests.instruction: Which word could help you figure out how a great-grandmother connects to you?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: This chart traces the path from you back to earlier relatives.
quests.explanation: Family Tree could help you figure out how a great-grandmother connects to you.
quests.funFact: Following the branches of a family tree is like following a map through your family's history!

quests.instruction: Which word means the group your grandparents proudly introduce to their friends?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: This word is used from a grandparent's proud point of view.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren means the group your grandparents proudly introduce to their friends.
quests.funFact: Grandparents often love showing off photos of their grandchildren to friends and neighbors!

quests.instruction: Which word would you use for people at a family reunion who are not your parents or siblings?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This word covers the wider group beyond your closest family.
quests.explanation: Relatives is the word for people at a family reunion who are not your parents or siblings.
quests.funFact: Family reunions are a great place to meet relatives you may not see very often!

quests.instruction: Which word means the relatives whose own grandchildren became your grandparents?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: Think of the parents of your grandparents' own parents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents means the relatives whose own grandchildren became your grandparents.
quests.funFact: This kind of family puzzle helps show just how connected every generation really is!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the people who might travel a long way to attend your birthday party?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: These relatives do not live in your own home.
quests.explanation: Extended Family describes the people who might travel a long way to attend your birthday party.
quests.funFact: Big celebrations are often when extended family travels the farthest to be together!

quests.instruction: Which word describes children who all call the same two people 'Mom' and 'Dad'?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: This word is about sharing the very same two parents.
quests.explanation: Siblings describes children who all call the same two people 'Mom' and 'Dad'.
quests.funFact: Sharing the same two parents is what makes the sibling connection so close!

quests.instruction: Which word means the earlier generations that came before your own grandparents?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word looks back many generations, past even your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Ancestors means the earlier generations that came before your own grandparents.
quests.funFact: Some families keep old letters or photographs to help remember their ancestors!

quests.instruction: Which word means one whole level on a family tree, like all the children of one couple?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word describes one row or level of a family tree.
quests.explanation: Generation means one whole level on a family tree, like all the children of one couple.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, each generation is often drawn on its own horizontal row!

quests.instruction: Which word means the everyday group of people you share meals and chores with at home?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: Think of who helps set the table or take out the trash with you.
quests.explanation: Household means the everyday group of people you share meals and chores with at home.
quests.funFact: Sharing chores is a common way household members help take care of their shared home!

quests.instruction: Which word means your household family, not your aunts, uncles, or cousins?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: This word points only to your closest relatives.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family means your household family, not your aunts, uncles, or cousins.
quests.funFact: Even one parent and one child together still count as an immediate family!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the kind of chart used to trace a family's history back many generations?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: This chart can stretch back further than just your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Family Tree describes the kind of chart used to trace a family's history back many generations.
quests.funFact: Some people spend years researching to build a family tree that goes back centuries!

quests.instruction: Which word describes you and your cousins, if you are looking at things from your shared grandparent's side?
quests.question: Grandchildren
quests.hint: This word is what a grandparent calls both you and your cousins.
quests.explanation: Grandchildren describes you and your cousins, from your shared grandparent's point of view.
quests.funFact: You and your cousins can both be grandchildren to the very same grandparent!

quests.instruction: Which word describes everyone connected to your family tree, whether you have met them or not?
quests.question: Relatives
quests.hint: This word does not require that you have actually met the person.
quests.explanation: Relatives describes everyone connected to your family tree, whether you have met them or not.
quests.funFact: Some people discover new relatives later in life through family history research!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the earliest generation shown on a simple four-generation family tree?
quests.question: Great-Grandparents
quests.hint: This is usually the very top layer of a shorter family tree.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandparents describes the earliest generation shown on a simple four-generation family tree.
quests.funFact: A four-generation family tree usually starts with you and stretches all the way up to this generation!

quests.instruction: Which word means your family circle including everyone beyond your own household?
quests.question: Extended Family
quests.hint: This word stretches past just the people living with you.
quests.explanation: Extended Family means your family circle including everyone beyond your own household.
quests.funFact: Extended family can include relatives from both sides of your family, near and far!

quests.instruction: Which word means the group you and your brothers or sisters make up together?
quests.question: Siblings
quests.hint: This word is about your closest brothers and sisters as a set.
quests.explanation: Siblings means the group you and your brothers or sisters make up together.
quests.funFact: Whether you have one sibling or five, this single word describes the whole group!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe relatives from a hundred years ago or more?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word fits relatives from long before you were born.
quests.explanation: Ancestors could describe relatives from a hundred years ago or more.
quests.funFact: Old photographs of ancestors can show us how family fashion and life have changed over time!

quests.instruction: Which word means a rung on the ladder of a family tree, connecting one age group to the next?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: Picture a ladder — this word is one rung, not the whole ladder.
quests.explanation: Generation means a rung on the ladder of a family tree, connecting one age group to the next.
quests.funFact: Some very long family trees can show ten or more generations, connected rung by rung!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe a family of any size, as long as they live in the same home?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: The size does not matter — what matters is living together.
quests.explanation: Household could describe a family of any size, as long as they live in the same home.
quests.funFact: A household could be just one person living alone, or a big family of ten!

quests.instruction: Which word means your parents and siblings, as opposed to your wider extended family?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: This is your closest circle, not your whole family tree.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family means your parents and siblings, as opposed to your wider extended family.
quests.funFact: The difference between immediate and extended family is really about closeness and daily contact!

quests.instruction: Which word means a chart with branches showing parents, grandparents, and children?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: This chart usually grows upward or outward like a plant.
quests.explanation: Family Tree means a chart with branches showing parents, grandparents, and children.
quests.funFact: Some family trees are drawn upside down, with the oldest relatives at the very top!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe a great-great-grandmother you never had the chance to meet?
quests.question: Ancestors
quests.hint: This word describes relatives from an earlier time in history.
quests.explanation: Ancestors could describe a great-great-grandmother you never had the chance to meet.
quests.funFact: Learning about ancestors you never met is a wonderful way to discover your family's story!

quests.instruction: Which word means one layer of a family tree, stacked above or below another layer?
quests.question: Generation
quests.hint: This word describes a horizontal layer, not the whole tree itself.
quests.explanation: Generation means one layer of a family tree, stacked above or below another layer.
quests.funFact: A four-generation family tree might show great-grandparents, grandparents, parents, and children!

quests.instruction: Which word could a form ask about when it wants to know how many people live at your address?
quests.question: Household
quests.hint: This is the official-sounding word for who lives at one address.
quests.explanation: Household could be asked about on a form that wants to know how many people live at your address.
quests.funFact: Official forms often use the word 'household' instead of 'family' because it is more precise about the home!

quests.instruction: Which word means the core group of your family, before counting any extended relatives?
quests.question: Immediate Family
quests.hint: Think of this as the very center of your family circle.
quests.explanation: Immediate Family means the core group of your family, before counting any extended relatives.
quests.funFact: Your immediate family is often the very first group of people a baby learns to recognize!

quests.instruction: Which word means a drawing with names organized by generation, like a real tree's branches?
quests.question: Family Tree
quests.hint: Each level of this drawing usually represents one generation.
quests.explanation: Family Tree means a drawing with names organized by generation, like a real tree's branches.
quests.funFact: The very bottom of a family tree usually shows the youngest generation, like you and your siblings!
